tiering: CORE = token measured in >= 3 of the clips; OPTIONAL = 1-2 clips. min-max across clips; median over the clips that have it (n).

page_background.mode_rule: frame = white page when > 70% of its edge pixels (left/right 4%, top 3%, bottom 5%) are card-white (min channel >= 253); otherwise tint. Both modes are normal: the page is NOT always tinted and NOT always white.

tint_gradient.note: centre_minus_edge_lum is NEGATIVE (median -2.5): the centre patch is slightly DARKER than the edge median (cards' shadows and light-blue elements sit there), while the side-edge stops show the middle band ~2.5 lum lighter than the top/bottom. Direction is not consistent between clips, magnitude <= 8 lum: treat the tint as flat.

colors.rule: one blue hue in 4-5 tints on a near-white field, black ink + one grey; yellow is a rare single accent

typography.assumption: x-height = 0.5 em (lower-case text) or digit/cap height = 0.70 em (digits roles); +-10%

typography.weight_basis: guess: stem/x-height ~0.35 = ExtraBold-Black class (800); small labels 700-800

transitions.cut_rule: UNRELIABLE for clips 2-4: their cuts come from the energy rule (E_peak>=9 or D_peak>=0.15, >=1s apart), which on clip 1 has precision 25/33 and recall 25/30 (tol 0.35s), and in a by-eye spot-check of 10 cuts per clip only 5/10, 6/10 and 8/10 were real (recall never checked). Cut-dependent tokens (cuts, shot length, cuts/min, end hold, transition shares and durations) therefore use clip 1's eye cuts only (n=1); clips 2-4 are listed in `values` but excluded from median/min/max/n.

7699100876736040244.method: 10 rule cuts evenly spaced in time, judged by eye on 0.9s strips (-0.3..+0.5s): real = the composition/title is replaced; in-shot = same scene keeps animating

build_defaults.rule: one value per token. Colours/sizes/specs: median over the clips that have it. Eases: the ease family most CORE clips share, ties broken toward the Power BI clip (clip 1); duration/overshoot = median over the clips of that family. Anything not measured is labelled guess.
build_defaults.status: proposal derived from measurements; the font is pending owner approval (chờ chủ duyệt)

colors.yellow_use: single small accent (highlight bar, flag); absent in 1 of 4 clips

page_background.when_to_use: two page modes, both normal. Tint (#eef7fc) is the default: 78% of frames (range 54-92%). White (22% of frames, range 8-46%) is used for the parts of the clip at 50-60%, 60-70% of the running time (median over clips). What triggers white inside a clip (title cards, quiet explainer scenes, end card) is NOT measured; pick per scene, and keep the surface cards `#ffffff` in both modes (on white they are separated by the shadow only).
page_background.note: the tint is practically flat (differences <= 8 lum). centre_minus_edge_lum median -2.7 = the centre patch is slightly DARKER than the edge median; the side-edge vertical stops show the middle band lighter than top/bottom, so the direction is inconsistent: use the flat colour. Scenes swing in tint between p10 and p90 (see tint lum range).

type_scale.colour_pattern: ink for plain words, accent_primary for the key word
type_scale.note: sizes are medians; display_number varies a lot between clips (see range_px) - pick per layout, the median is the default

font.status: chủ duyệt 2026-11-03: chọn Be Vietnam Pro thay Montserrat (xếp đầu theo IoU) vì độ rộng chữ chỉ lệch 5% so với 15%, xuống dòng giống gốc
font.weight_rule: weight whose rendered stem/x-height is closest to the measured 0.33 (headline, 4 clips); per-weight stem ratios and IoU in fonts.<family>.per_weight
font.rule: eligible = single font with 100% of the Vietnamese codepoints (Fontsource files); rank by mean over the 8 cropped strings of the best-weight raw IoU (rendered text resized to the crop's ink box vs the crop); aspect error (width/height of rendered text vs crop) is reported separately, not mixed into the rank

excluded.Outfit (primary): 28.4% Vietnamese coverage (no vietnamese subset); 'Outfit + Be Vietnam Pro fallback' is a mixed font, listed for comparison only (mean_best_iou 0.536)

font.caveat: the reference letters look single-storey (a, g) like Outfit; none of the eligible fonts has a single-storey a. IoU is a rough shape match, not font identification: choose by eye on a test scene.
